C1524.title: EIP-7702 Phishing Attacks: Exploiting New Account Abstraction Features to Drain Assets
C1524.summary: Academic research reveals that EIP-7702 introduces a novel class of phishing attacks. Instead of tricking users into signing a single transaction, attackers can induce them to sign an authorization that rewrites their account into a malicious contract, gaining full control and leveraging ERC-4337 infrastructure to transfer assets.
